steps: Rate of change = gradient of tangent (instantaneous) or chord (average)
For iteration: rearrange f(x) = 0 into x = g(x)
Start with x₀ and repeatedly apply xₙ₊₁ = g(xₙ)
Continue until values stabilise to the required accuracy
Check convergence: show change of sign around the root
method_card.title: How to Work with Rates of Change & Iteration
method_card.content:
A rate of change measures how one quantity changes with respect to another. On a graph, the rate of change at a point equals the gradient of the tangent at that point.

Average rate of change between two points = gradient of the chord between them: \(\frac{f(b) - f(a)}{b - a}\).

Iteration is a method for solving equations by repeated substitution. Starting from \(x_0\), apply a formula \(x_{n+1} = g(x_n)\) to generate a sequence that converges to the solution.

To set up iteration: rearrange the equation \(f(x) = 0\) into the form \(x = g(x)\), then iterate.

prerequisites.title: Gradients of Curves & Areas Under Graphs

gold.display: \(f(x) = x^3 + 2x - 7\). Show a root lies between 1 and 2. What is \(f(1.5)\) to 2 d.p.?
The population P of a town is modelled by \(P = 5000 \times 1.03^t\). Find the average annual rate of change between \(t = 0\) and \(t = 10\). Give to the nearest whole number.
The equation \(x^3 - 5x - 3 = 0\) can be rearranged to \(x = \sqrt[3]{5x + 3}\). Using \(x_0 = 2\), find \(x_1\) to 3 d.p.

bronze.display: Find the average rate of change of \(y = x^2\) between \(x = 1\) and \(x = 3\).
Find the average rate of change of \(y = 2x + 3\) between \(x = 0\) and \(x = 5\).

misconceptions.message: f(0) = 3, f(5) = 13. Rate = (13 − 3)/5 = 10/5 = 2. For a linear function, the rate of change is constant (the gradient).

bronze.display: Show there is a root of \(x^2 - 7 = 0\) between \(x = 2\) and \(x = 3\). What is \(f(2)\)?
For the same equation, what is \(f(3)\)?

misconceptions.message: f(3) = 9 − 7 = 2. Since f(2) < 0 and f(3) > 0, there's a sign change = root between 2 and 3.
x₁ = 2 + 3 = 5. Simply substitute x₀ into the formula.

bronze.display: Find the average rate of change of \(y = x^2\) between \(x = 2\) and \(x = 4\).
What does a positive rate of change mean on a graph?
options: The graph has a turning point

misconceptions.message: Positive rate of change = positive gradient = graph is going up.

silver.display: Using \(x_{n+1} = \frac{10}{x_n + 1}\) with \(x_0 = 2\), find \(x_1\). Give answer as a fraction.

misconceptions.message: f(3) = 27 − 12 − 1 = 14. Sign change from f(2) = −1 confirms a root between 2 and 3.

silver.display: Find the average rate of change of \(y = x^3\) between \(x = 1\) and \(x = 2\).
Show that \(x^2 - 3x + 1 = 0\) has a root between \(x = 0\) and \(x = 1\). What is \(f(0)\)?
For the same equation, what is \(f(1)\)?

misconceptions.message: f(1) = 1 − 3 + 1 = −1. Sign change confirms root between 0 and 1.

steps.label: Conclude
steps.content: Sign change between x = 2 and x = 3, so there is a root in this interval.

worked_examples.question: Show that x³ − 3x − 5 = 0 has a root between x = 2 and x = 3.
